text: {"lessons":["I sold all five positions at gains, then bought them back later; frequent timing decisions can be counterproductive, so I should trade only when my plan or the investment outlook changes.","Holding through the declines after Period 6 avoided panic selling, but holding losing positions by default is not a strategy; I should reassess each stock on its merits.","My account value rose only modestly before flattening and then fluctuated, reminding me that short-term moves are uncertain; I should focus on long-term goals and review my portfolio periodically."]}
